verdict.rationale: Qodo automatically reviews every pull request once connected and enforces standards across every repository at scale without manual intervention. Its blast-radius risk labels let teams triage which PRs need the closest human review. The Agentic Toolbox (CLI, MCP, and Claude Code/Codex/Kiro plugins) puts Qodo review inside coding agents so they can review changes before opening a PR and resolve findings, which fits verifying high-volume agent-authored code. Missing for 10: explicit handling or detection of AI/agent-authored PRs, evidence of review throughput or accuracy at high volume, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the reviewer catches defects in agent code.
